records.jp: やりたいこと……？
records.en: Things I want to do...?

records.jp: うん。私たちは、私たちの想いを使って<CR>世界を再構築しようとしてるでしょ？
records.en_original: Yeah. I mean, we're rebuilding the world based on our emotions, right?
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah. I mean, we're rebuilding the world based on our emotions, right?
records.en: We're trying to rebuild the world<CR>using our feelings, right?

records.jp: ってことは、今のうちに「これしたい！」って<CR>いろいろ考えておけば、その通りになるかもって！
records.en_original: Which means if you keep the things you want to do in mind, you may get to do them when the world gets remade!
records.en_auxiliary: Which means if you keep the things you want to do in mind, you may get to do them when the world gets remade!
records.en: So if we think of lots of things we want to do now,<CR>maybe they'll happen exactly that way!

records.jp: だから、こころのやりたいこと、教えてよ！
records.en: So tell me what you want to do, Kokoro!

records.jp: ふふっ、なるほど。<CR>そういうことなら、たくさんあるよ
records.en_original: Hehe, I see. In that case, there are a lot of things I want to do.
records.en_auxiliary: Hehe, I see. In that case, there are a lot of things I want to do.
records.en: Hehe, I see.<CR>In that case, there are so many things.

records.jp: 例えば――
records.en: For example...

records.jp: 愛央ちゃんと一緒に食べ歩きしたい
records.en_original: Getting a snack somewhere and going for a walk with you.
records.en_auxiliary: Getting a snack somewhere and going for a walk with you.
records.en: I want to go around trying different foods with you, Ao-chan.

records.jp: 映画を見に行きたい
records.en: I want to go see a movie.

records.jp: あとは…お家に遊びに行きたいな
records.en_original: And... I want to go over to your house.
records.en_auxiliary: And... I want to go over to your house.
records.en: And...I'd like to visit your home.

records.jp: 私ばっかだね
records.en: They're all about me, huh.
Wh-what...?

records.jp: ああ、いや……私と一緒にしたいこととか、<CR>そういうのばっかりだなって思って
records.en_original: Oh, no... It's just, they all seem like things you want to do with me.
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, no... It's just, they all seem like things you want to do with me.
records.en: Oh, no...I just noticed they're all things<CR>you want to do with me.

records.jp: ご、ごめん！　思いついたのが、そればっかりで……
records.en_original: S-sorry! Those were just the first things that popped into my head...
records.en_auxiliary: S-sorry! Those were just the first things that popped into my head...
records.en: S-sorry! Those were the only things that came to mind...

records.jp: ううん、謝らないで。……嬉しいの
records.en: No, don't apologize. I'm...happy.

records.jp: こころがそうやって考えてくれて……嬉しい
records.en_original: I'm glad you feel that way.
records.en_auxiliary: I'm glad you feel that way.
records.en: I'm happy you think of me that way.

records.jp: 愛央ちゃん……
records.en: Ao-chan...

records.jp: でも……私の家、面白いものとか何もないよ？
records.en_original: But you know... There's nothing fun at my house.
records.en_auxiliary: But you know... There's nothing fun at my house.
records.en: But...there's nothing interesting at my house, you know?

records.jp: ふふっ、いいんだよ。<CR>愛央ちゃんのお家なのが重要なんだから
records.en_original: Hehe, I don't mind. All that matters is that it's your house.
records.en_auxiliary: Hehe, I don't mind. All that matters is that it's your house.
records.en: Hehe, that's fine.<CR>What matters is that it's your home, Ao-chan.

records.jp: ……そういうもんかな
records.en: I wonder if that's how it works...

records.jp: そういうもんだよ
records.en: That's just how it is.

records.jp: 愛央ちゃんは、他にしたいことはある？
records.en_original: Do you have anything you'd like to do, Ao?
records.en_auxiliary: Do you have anything you'd like to do, Ao?
records.en: Do you have anything you'd like to do, Ao-chan?

records.jp: そうだなぁ……
records.en: Let's see...

records.jp: 一緒にお買い物に行って、服を見たり
records.en: We could go shopping together and look at clothes.

records.jp: 休みの日には、少し遠くまで出かけてみたり
records.en_original: Going on a little weekend trip.
records.en_auxiliary: Going on a little weekend trip.
records.en: On our days off, we could go somewhere a little farther away.

records.jp: そんな、何でもない日常が過ごせたらいいね
records.en_original: I hope we'll be able to spend our days peacefully like that.
records.en_auxiliary: I hope we'll be able to spend our days peacefully like that.
records.en: I hope we can share an ordinary life like that.

records.jp: きっとできるよ。どれだけ離れていても、<CR>わたしたちは想いでつながってるから
records.en_original: I know we will. No matter how far apart we are, our feelings will bring us together.
records.en_auxiliary: I know we will. No matter how far apart we are, our feelings will bring us together.
records.en: I'm sure we can. No matter how far apart we are,<CR>we're connected by our feelings.

records.jp: ……うん
records.en: ...Yeah.

records.jp: 次の世界でも、きっとまた出会えるよね
records.en_original: We'll see each other in the next world.
records.en_auxiliary: We'll see each other in the next world.
records.en: We'll surely meet again in the next world, won't we?

records.jp: うん、きっと――――
records.en: Yeah, surely—

records.jp: 会いたい
records.en: I want to see you.

records.jp: 愛央ちゃんに会いたい
records.en: I want to see you, Ao-chan.

records.jp: わたしは、奇跡を信じる
records.en: I believe in miracles.
